title: A very long name stops at 60 characters, and says so
note: The person pastes 90 letters. The field keeps the first 60 and a quiet line explains the limit, so nothing is cut without a word. The cover sets the name in three lines and fades it, never an ellipsis.
text: Back Who is this book for? AAAAAAA Name A name can have up to 60 characters. Add another child Birthday Not here yet Birthday Born today Choose AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA's birthday to continue.
lines: A name can have up to 60 characters.
